flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: The membership renews automatically for successive 12-month terms at the then-current rate without a fresh signature, and does not end on its own.

flags.sourceSentence: Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full.
flags.consequence: Missing the cancellation deadline commits the signer to a further full 12-month term at the then-current rate, which may be higher, and the dues for that term remain payable in full.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, hours, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement itself at any time, with the change applying from the date it is posted, and the signer's continued use counts as acceptance — with no cap on increases and no right to leave without penalty stated.

flags.sourceSentence: Your continued use of any facility after an amended version is posted is your acceptance of it.
flags.consequence: The signer's continued use of any facility after an amendment is posted is treated as acceptance of the amended terms, including changes they have not agreed to.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Meridian's legal fees and any third-party claim arising from their use of the facilities, their conduct, their guest's conduct, or any service they provide to another member, with no cap, and Meridian chooses the lawyer and can block any settlement.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after the signer's Program candidacy ends for any reason, they cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness instruction or personal training, as employee, contractor or on their own account, at any facility within 15 miles of any Meridian location where they taught or trained, and cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join any class, collective or representative action against Meridian; disputes go to a single arbitrator whose award is final.

flags.sourceSentence: A membership that has been suspended, frozen or placed on medical hold continues to renew on its original schedule.
flags.consequence: A suspended, frozen or medically held membership still renews into further 12-month terms, so the signer can be billed for a full term while unable or not using the facility.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: Late-payment, returned-payment, keycard replacement and account reinstatement charges are set in a separate Schedule of Fees the signer has not been given, so the amounts are unknown at signing and can be changed by posting.

flags.sourceSentence: You authorise Meridian to draw all dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on your account until this Agreement has ended and your balance is nil.
flags.consequence: The signer authorises ongoing automatic withdrawals of all dues, tuition and charges from their payment method until the agreement ends and the balance is nil, including charges under a Schedule of Fees they have not seen.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: Meridian's total liability for any claim — including negligence — is capped at the dues and fees the signer paid in the previous 12 months, and it is not liable for lost income, lost business opportunity, or loss of or damage to personal property, including property left in a locker.

flags.sourceSentence: Candidates are expected to complete sixty (60) supervised teaching hours in each Program year, and a candidate who falls short may be held back a year at Meridian’s discretion.
flags.consequence: A candidate who completes fewer than 60 supervised teaching hours in a Program year can be held back a year, at Meridian's discretion, extending the time and tuition needed to finish.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program tuition renews automatically each year at the then-current rate, which may be higher, unless the signer gives written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary date.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: The signer is responsible for every entry made with their keycard or account, so unauthorised use by another person could lead to charges or rule-violation consequences attributed to the signer.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the signer ends the licence early, they lose the whole $45 fee for the remaining months of the season, even though the Association keeps the same refund right for itself when it ends the licence.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any equipment or belongings the signer leaves on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, netting, frames or anything else — becomes the Association's property to keep or throw away, with no compensation and no duty to store or return them.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Northwind can raise the price of the signer's own plan with 30 days' email notice, and the new fee applies from the next Billing Period with no cap on the increase and no stated right to leave without paying the higher rate.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: If the signer misses the cancellation deadline on an annual plan, the subscription automatically extends for another full twelve months at whatever the annual fee is at that time, and the signer owes it.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: Northwind can rewrite any term of the agreement — including pricing, the Fee Schedule and the signer's obligations — by posting it on its website, and the signer is treated as having accepted the new version simply by continuing to use the service, with no cap, no consent requirement and no stated right to exit the changed deal.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to sue Northwind in court or join a class action: every dispute must go to individual binding arbitration, the award is final, and the signer cannot act as a class member even where many users share the same problem.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: A missed or failed payment triggers interest at 1.5% per month (18% a year) on the unpaid amount, plus a reactivation charge whose amount is set in a Fee Schedule the signer was not given, so the total cost of a lapsed payment is open-ended and partly invisible.

flags.sourceSentence: Where availability in a calendar month falls below that figure, your remedy is the service credit set out in the Service Credit Policy and nothing further.
flags.consequence: If monthly availability falls below 99.5%, the signer's only remedy is a service credit defined in a Service Credit Policy the signer was not given, and they give up any other claim for the outage — including for lost work or revenue caused by it.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: If the service fails — including losing the signer's work, revenue or a failed export — the signer's total recovery from Northwind is capped at the amount paid for the single Billing Period in which the claim arose, which could be a small fraction of the actual loss.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's legal costs and cover any third-party claim connected to content they uploaded, exported or published — an open-ended exposure that includes copyright, trade mark and privacy claims, with no cap stated.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: Northwind can suspend the signer's account — cutting off access to their work — based on its own unreviewed belief that more than one person is using it, with no stated notice period or limit on how long the suspension lasts.

flags.sourceSentence: Your subscription continues from one Billing Period into the next without further action by either of us, and we bill the plan fee then in effect on the first day of each new Billing Period.
flags.consequence: The subscription renews automatically each Billing Period without any fresh confirmation, and the signer is billed the then-current fee on the first day of each new period unless they cancel in time.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels on or after the first day of a Billing Period, they lose the entire fee already collected for that period — up to a full month, or a full year's worth if a monthly-equivalent period is at issue on an annual plan.

flags.sourceSentence: Closing an account stops future Billing Periods and does not refund a Billing Period already begun.
flags.consequence: If the signer closes their account partway through a Billing Period, they lose the fee for the period already begun, with no pro-rata refund.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can unilaterally introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, benefit plan, or term of employment described in the letter — including compensation-related terms — at any time without the signer's agreement, with the change taking effect as soon as it is published on the company intranet. The clause names no cap on changes, no advance notice period, and no right to leave without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends — even if Ardent ends it — the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the 'Restricted Field' defined in Exhibit B, which the signer has not been given, and cannot approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers. This could block the signer's primary source of income in their specialised field for a year.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses, liabilities and attorney fees arising from an alleged breach of the confidentiality or post-termination sections, or from a former employer's claim that the new job breaches an obligation owed to that former employer — an open-ended amount with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to take employment-related claims — including statutory claims — to court or a jury, and cannot join a class, collective or representative action; all claims must go to individual binding arbitration, which removes the class route that could make small claims economically viable.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: If the signer resigns or is fired for cause within 12 months of the 4 May 2026 start date, the entire $15,000 signing payment must be repaid within 30 days of their last working day, even if the departure is for reasons outside their control such as a layoff framed as cause or a role they cannot continue in.

flags.sourceSentence: On or before your start date you will sign the Employee Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement enclosed with this letter.
flags.consequence: The signer must sign a separate Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement before starting, but has not been given its terms beyond the fact that it survives the end of employment, so they are committing to unknown confidentiality and invention-assignment obligations.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The occupant must maintain full-value insurance on everything stored and show proof on request; if they do not, they bear the entire risk of loss themselves, and the Operator's liability for loss or damage — including damage caused by the Operator's own negligence — is capped at $5,000 unless the occupant declared a higher value and paid a value protection fee.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must pay for and defend the Operator against every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense — including attorney fees — brought by anyone arising from the occupant's use of the unit or premises, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant lets onto the premises, with no cap on the amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The Operator can change the rent, the rules, gate hours, and any other term of the agreement on its own, with the changes taking effect the first day of the month after notice is posted and emailed — the occupant has no right to agree or object, and no stated right to leave without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: If rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator holds a lien on everything in the unit, can block the occupant's access and overlock the unit, and after the required notice period can sell the contents and keep the proceeds to cover what is owed — meaning the occupant could lose all stored property over an unpaid amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: The late charge and the per-notice administration charges are not stated in the agreement itself; they are set in a Schedule of Charges posted in the office and on a website, so the occupant is agreeing to amounts they cannot see in this document, and each additional notice about an unpaid balance adds another charge that can accumulate.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews itself month to month automatically with no end date, so it will not terminate on its own; the occupant must give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop it, and rent paid for the move-out month is not refunded.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: Rent already paid for the month in which the occupant moves out is not refunded, so the occupant pays for days they will not use if they leave mid-month.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan automatically renews for another twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate unless the signer tells Cascade to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term, committing the signer to a full extra year at a higher, unstated rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels a promotional plan before its term ends, the entire unpaid device instalment balance becomes due immediately on the next bill, which could be a large lump sum; the amount is not stated in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term of the agreement, any charge, and any feature of the rate plan on notice delivered by bill, device message or email, and the signer accepts the change just by continuing to use the service. The clause names no cap on increases and no right to leave without penalty except for material increases to the monthly recurring charge, so other changes (features, data allowances, fees) could take effect with no penalty-free exit.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover any claim, loss or expense, including Cascade's reasonable legal fees, arising from use of the service, anything sent from or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone the signer allows, or any charge incurred on the account — an open-ended obligation with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: All disputes are resolved by individual binding arbitration, and the signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, so serious problems could not be pursued as a group or before a jury.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: Cascade can introduce, increase or remove the Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and the Administrative Charge on notice given with the bill in which the change first appears, and these are acknowledged not to be government-required, so the signer's monthly cost can rise with as little as one bill's notice and no exit right stated for this clause.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance incurs a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance, applied every bill period until paid, so the charge compounds on an ongoing unpaid amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Continuing to use the service after the effective date of a change accepts the change.
flags.consequence: Continuing to use the service after a change takes effect is treated as accepting it, so the signer can be bound by new terms without signing anything.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim is limited to the service charges for one bill period on the affected line, and lost profits, lost data and indirect or consequential losses are excluded, so a serious service failure could leave the signer with a recovery of at most roughly one month's charges.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: When the signer cancels, charges accrue to the end of the bill period and the part bill period is not prorated, so the signer pays for days of service they will not use after cancelling.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme at any point for any reason on one week's written notice, cutting off the remaining stipend weeks with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can change the Handbook, the assessments, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement itself at any time, with the change taking effect simply by emailing it — including changes to pay-related terms or obligations — with no cap, no advance notice period and no right for the Analyst to leave without penalty.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any role — paid or unpaid, employee, contractor or intern — with any firm on a Restricted List they may not fully know in advance (issued in week one and possibly reissued later), and cannot approach clients they worked on, limiting their job options after the Programme.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay the Firm's claims, losses, expenses and legal costs arising from a breach of confidentiality or the post-programme restrictions, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients — an open-ended amount with no cap, triggered even by non-malicious publications.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, and must pursue any dispute — including over pay, termination or the restrictive covenants — alone in individual, final and binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late instalment of the housing advance accrues a late charge, in an amount set in the Programme Handbook the signer has not seen, continuing until the advance is repaid in full — so the charge can grow the longer repayment is delayed.

flags.sourceSentence: This obligation has no end date.
flags.consequence: The confidentiality obligation never expires — the Analyst must keep client names, models, memoranda and data confidential for life and cannot retain any copies, a standing restriction that outlasts the Programme indefinitely.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: If the laptop, security token or building pass is not returned within five working days of the last day, the Analyst is charged the replacement cost stated in the Programme Handbook, an amount the signer cannot see in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: A place given up later than that, and before the third lesson, is refunded at half the fee.
flags.consequence: If the family gives up the place between seven days before the first lesson and the third lesson, they lose half the $120 fee ($60) for lessons not yet received.

flags.sourceSentence: After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: Once the third lesson has happened, the entire $120 fee is forfeited for the remaining lessons, even if the child stops attending after lesson three.
